# bp evaluation data

* `bp_synthetic_financial.jsonl` is generated by `python -m eval.make_dataset` (seed 7): 30 plans with one injected fault each (9 fault kinds) plus 20 valid plans. Regenerate rather than edit.
* `bp_handscored_sample.jsonl` does not exist yet. It must hold about 10 real or realistic plans scored by hand per section (0-100), so rubric agreement can be measured. Until then `/v1/eval` reports it as not measured.
* Keep development, calibration and test plans in separate files before quoting any number.
